user.title: Librus Synergia (unofficial)
user.description: Log in with your Librus login (e.g. "1234567u") and password. This uses Librus's private web API and may violate Librus's Terms of Service - use your own account at your own risk. Your session normally expires after about a day with no way to silently renew it without your password, so - unlike some integrations - your password IS stored (alongside the session) to allow unattended daily refresh; it never leaves your Home Assistant instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Librus Synergia
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {login} could not be renewed. Enter the password again to log in.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Librus Synergia
reconfigure.description: Fix the login or password for this entry. The login must still belong to the same Librus account this entry was set up for.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Check the login/password.
error.captcha_needed: Librus is asking for a captcha, which this integration cannot solve automatically. Try again later, or log in once via the official Librus app/website first.
error.account_action_required: Your Librus account needs an action on Librus's own site first (accept rules, or change your password), then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Librus servers.

abort.already_configured: This Librus account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This login belongs to a different Librus account than the one this entry was set up for. Remove and re-add the integration instead if you meant to add a new student.

ai_summary.title: Weekly AI summary
ai_summary.description: Once a week, an AI model of your choice writes a summary of the school week: grades, attendance, behaviour and the week ahead. It uses Home Assistant's AI Task - set up any AI provider (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, a local Ollama...) first. Only data this integration already has is sent, to the provider you pick.

data_description.ai_task_entity: The AI Task entity to use. Leave empty to turn the feature off.
data_description.ai_audience: The parent (third person, what you can do) or the student (written to them directly, encouraging).
data_description.ai_weekday: The summary covers the 7 days up to this day and previews the 7 days after it.
data_description.ai_time: Local time of the automatic run. A run missed because Home Assistant was off is made up within 2 days.
data_description.ai_include_messages: Off by default: private messages and school announcements are then never sent to the AI provider. On adds a "From the school" section.
data_description.ai_extra_context: Optional, e.g. "Eighth-grade exam this year, chemistry is the weaker subject".

data.average_mode: Grade average shown as the sensor state
data.student_number: Student's number in the class register

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh grades, attendance, timetable and announcements. Keep this modest - it is an unofficial API.
data_description.messages_enabled: When off, the Unread messages sensor goes unavailable and no messages calls are made - fewer requests to Librus.
data_description.announcements_enabled: When off, the Unread announcements sensor goes unavailable and no SchoolNotices calls are made.
data_description.behaviour_grades_enabled: When off, the Behaviour grade sensor goes unavailable and no BehaviourGrades calls are made.
data_description.descriptive_grades_enabled: When off, the Descriptive grades sensor goes unavailable and no DescriptiveGrades calls are made.
data_description.free_days_enabled: When off, the Free days calendar entity is not created and no free-days calls are made.
data_description.average_mode: Weighted uses each grade category's weight (what Librus itself shows). Arithmetic is a plain mean of the same grades. Both stay available as attributes either way.
data_description.student_number: Optional - the number is read from Librus automatically (its Informacje page). Fill this in only to override it. The Lucky number sensor uses it to show whether it's your number.
data_description.grade_thresholds: Minimum average for a 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, comma separated (e.g. 1.75, 2.75, 3.75, 4.75, 5.50). Check your school's statute (WSO) - schools use different ones. Used by the Grade forecast sensor and the Grade at risk binary sensor.
data_description.hide_empty_subjects: No average sensor for a subject until it gets its first grade (e.g. Religia early in the year). Existing sensors of such subjects are removed; they come back with the first grade.
data_description.smart_polling: Saves requests when nothing is happening. On school days between 06:00 and 22:00 data is refreshed at the poll interval above. On a day without lessons (weekend, holidays) at most once an hour, and at night (22:00-06:00) at most every 3 hours. The Refresh action (librus_synergia.refresh) always fetches straight away. Quiet hours below, if on, still apply.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: When on, no data is fetched from Librus during the window below - entities just keep their last known state overnight.
data_description.quiet_hours_start: Only used while quiet hours are enabled above.
data_description.quiet_hours_end: Only used while quiet hours are enabled above. Can be earlier than the start time (e.g. 23:00 -> 06:00) to span midnight.

abort.no_ai_task: The AI Task integration is not available. Set up an AI provider (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama...) in Home Assistant 2025.8 or newer first.

school_year_rollover.title: School year end date looks out of date

confirm.title: Reload to re-check the school year
confirm.description: The cached school year end date ({end_date}) is over a month in the past. This usually updates automatically within 24 hours as Librus publishes the new school year's class record, but if it hasn't yet, reload the integration now to force an immediate re-check.

optional_endpoint_degraded.title: "{label}" has not responded in over a week
optional_endpoint_degraded.description: The "{label}" endpoint has failed on every attempt since {since}. This is often harmless - some schools/account types don't have every Librus module, and this integration already treats that as normal - but a full week of unbroken failures can also mean something changed (a permission change, or Librus reworking that endpoint). This is informational only and can be safely dismissed; it will reappear if the endpoint keeps failing.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Force an immediate data refresh instead of waiting for the next poll.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The student to refresh. Leave empty to refresh every configured student.

get_message.name: Get message
get_message.description: Fetches ONE message's full, untruncated content from Librus. This marks the message as read on Librus's servers, exactly like opening it in the Librus app or website - only call this for a message a person has actually chosen to open, never automatically or on a schedule.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Librus Synergia device (student) to fetch the message from.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: The message's id, from the Unread messages sensor's "recent" attribute.

mailbox.name: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Which mailbox the message is in. Defaults to "inbox" - use "substitutions" or "alerts" for a message from the Unread messages sensor's "substitutions_recent" or "alerts_recent" attribute.

get_grades.name: Get grades
get_grades.description: Returns every grade for a student in one response, optionally filtered to one subject - instead of reading each subject sensor's own "grades" attribute separately.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Librus Synergia device (student) to fetch grades for.

subject_id.name: Subject ID
subject_id.description: Limit to one subject's grades, using the subject average sensor's "subject_id" attribute. Leave empty for every subject.
